title: Entwicklung eines Entscheidungsunterstützungssystems (EUS) für die Auswahl von Verfahren zur Instandsetzung von Einkammerschleusen für die Schifffahrt unter laufendem Betrieb
summary: A two-stage decision support system (DSS) was developed for the selection of maintenance procedures for single-chamber locks while they are in operation. The Choosing by Advantages Decision Making System (CBA) tabular method was selected to form the basis of the DSS. A generalized decision-making process, a tool, and a seminar were developed for verification and validation.
